newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) CUTS GASOLINE PRICES.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PUBLIC PETROLEUM (DEP) CUTS GASOLINE PRICES.

text.p: Greece's Public Petroleum Corporation (DEP) will reduce gasoline prices by 2.10 drachmas per litre, effective on Thursday.
Heating fuel prices will be increased by 0.90 drachmas and transport diesel by 2.1 drachmas per litre, it said.

The price adjustments come after world gasoline, heating oil and diesel prices fell by $8.87, $3.1 and $7.7 per metric tonne and a softer dollar/drachma exchange rate, down 0.15 drachmas per $, DEP said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
